what: The round banner pinned to a screen corner (apply and tour buttons) turns transparent in .3s while scrolling so it does not cover text, and reappears in .3s once scrolling has stopped for .35s

options.wait: Time until reappearing after stopping (s), default .35
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Fade-out and return length/curve (via style), default .3s ease

note: While hidden it takes no presses either (pointer-events none) — the original was pressable even when transparent

from.where: shared.js .fix_brn_flx (two round yellow and orange banners at bottom right — original bnrTrigger, transition .3s)
